meta.title: Online Boutique
meta.subtitle: C4 model of Google's cloud-native microservices demo shop (GoogleCloudPlatform/microservices-demo).

glossary.gRPC: Google Remote Procedure Call: binary RPC over HTTP/2 with Protocol Buffers contracts (protos/demo.proto)
glossary.RESP: Redis Serialization Protocol, the wire protocol Redis clients speak over TCP
glossary.RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation: the LLM answers using products retrieved from a vector store

elements.name: Shopper
elements.description: Browses products, fills a cart and places orders without signing up.

elements.name: Online Boutique
elements.description: Web shop for vintage items built as gRPC microservices on Kubernetes.

elements.name: frontend
elements.description: Serves the website over HTTP and creates a session ID for every visitor.

elements.name: checkoutservice
elements.description: Places orders: reads the cart, charges, ships and sends the confirmation.

elements.name: cartservice
elements.description: Adds, reads and empties each user's shopping cart.

elements.name: productcatalogservice
elements.description: Lists, searches and returns products from a JSON file.

elements.name: currencyservice
elements.description: Converts money between currencies; the highest-QPS service.

elements.name: paymentservice
elements.description: Charges the credit card (mock) and returns a transaction ID.

elements.name: shippingservice
elements.description: Quotes shipping cost for a cart and ships orders (mock).

elements.name: recommendationservice
elements.description: Recommends other products based on what is in the cart.

elements.name: adservice
elements.description: Returns text ads matching the given context words.

elements.name: shoppingassistantservice
elements.description: Optional add-on: AI assistant that suggests products using RAG.

elements.name: loadgenerator
elements.description: Continuously replays realistic shopping flows against the frontend.

elements.name: redis-cart
elements.description: Stores the contents of every shopping cart.

elements.name: Google Gemini API
elements.description: Generative AI model that writes answers and product embeddings.

elements.name: AlloyDB for PostgreSQL
elements.description: Managed Google Cloud database holding the product vector store.

views.label: System Context
views.description: Online Boutique, the shopper who uses it, and the Google Cloud services the optional shopping assistant depends on.

views.label: Containers: browsing
views.description: Browsing flow: the gRPC services the frontend calls to render pages, the cart store and the load generator. The call to checkoutservice and the AI assistant are in their own views.

views.label: Containers: checkout
views.description: Checkout flow: how checkoutservice orchestrates cart, catalog, currency, shipping, payment and email over gRPC. Browsing calls from the frontend and the cart store are in the browsing view.

views.label: Containers: AI assistant
views.description: Optional shopping assistant add-on (kustomize component): the frontend forwards questions to a RAG service backed by Gemini and AlloyDB.
